author: AI arithmetic agent, without inherited project context

methodology.allowed_reads: Only the four named input files; no scorer, quality report, other result/source/history files, directory listing, network, subagent, or retrieval rerun.
methodology.unit: Exact id+revision tuple. ranked order preserved; only first five ranked entries for Recall@5.
methodology.denominator: The identical resolved positive-gold questions for both routes. Per-question hits/gold size, then macro average. Failure, cancellation/refusal, unqueried or empty eligible rows count zero.
methodology.empty_gold: Excluded from recall; separately report candidate return rate. Never count empty gold as recall success.
methodology.clarification: Excluded from recall and separately verify zero query_count and commits.
methodology.full_candidate_recall: Same per-question macro recall using entire ranked list.
methodology.no_candidate: Numerator resolved READY rows with zero ranked candidates; report divided by all resolved and separately actual resolved READY.
methodology.outcomes: Mutually exclusive outcome categories; total unqueried count is additional and overlaps refusal/abstention.
methodology.H: Count term_edit_required:true plans over all resolved; actual terms action question/event counts separately. Date from/through counted separately.
methodology.gold_currentness: Gold specifies exact relevant revisions. No permitted corpus, so independent currentness verification for non-gold returned units is outside scope.
methodology.sensitivity: Only predeclared q04 narrow r09 used separately; main adjudicated gold preserved.

limitations: AI arithmetic review is neither human evaluation nor real-user research, and cannot prove the relevance labels are correct.
Plan flags are counted from observations; four-file scope cannot independently establish blind/prequery plan provenance, since frozen action files are not permitted.
